result.title: Text-Guided Modality Correction for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
result.summary: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) is essential for detecting objects beyond the categories seen during training. Establishing vision-language associations is crucial for recognizing unseen categories, while integrating complementary visual features across levels supports detection at different scales. However, existing methods often provide insufficient textual guidance for object regions, rely on limited cross-modal alignment strategies, and underuse complementary features across levels, limiting their ability to detect unseen categories and objects of varying scales. To address these limitations, we propose a Text-Guided Modality Correction Network (TMCNet) that incorporates textual guidance into region feature extraction, cross-modal alignment, and multi-scale decoding to strengthen region-category semantic correspondence and promote complementary feature fusion across levels. First, a text-guided modality encoder incorporates textual semantics into queries to guide regional feature aggregation, reducing semantic ambiguity in object representations. Second, a cross-modal alignment module strengthens the correspondence between region representations and category semantics through interactions between visual and textual features. Finally, a progressive text correction decoder combines a top-down pathway with lateral connections to progressively fuse text-guided deep semantic features with shallow visual features at the corresponding scales, preserving both semantic information and spatial detail for objects of different sizes. Experiments on two public datasets, COCO-OVD and LVIS-OVD, demonstrate that TMCNet achieves strong performance in open-vocabulary object detection using simple text queries as guidance. Extending TMCNet to open-vocabulary segmentation also yields performance gains, demonstrating its cross-task applicability and extensibility.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向开放词汇目标检测提出 TMCNet：用文本语义引导区域特征聚合，通过跨模态对齐模块强化区域表示与类别语义的对应，并用渐进式文本修正解码器自顶向下融合深层语义与浅层视觉特征，以兼顾不同尺度目标。在 COCO-OVD 与 LVIS-OVD 上验证，并扩展到开放词汇分割。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是检测任务方法而非 LVR 研究，但「文本引导的查询聚合＋跨层特征修正」可能可供核查 latent 状态如何在任务语义约束下保留空间细节、以及视觉证据筛选与多尺度融合的借鉴线索。
